prompt:
A cinematic, premium food-character poster, vertical 3:4. Use the reference image for the world and the exact character designs: the big round dark iron Chongqing hotpot with glossy red chili oil broth, the warm lantern-lit Chongqing restaurant, and the food characters with googly eyes (white eyeballs, black pupils), small toothless mouths and tiny arms and legs of their own material: cooked fatty beef roll, flat dark velvety tripe sheet, duck blood cube, tofu cube with a cilantro leaf on its head, dried red chilies, Sichuan peppercorn clusters, garlic cloves, scallion pieces. Photorealistic textures.

The title is a physical object in the scene: the four Simplified Chinese characters 重庆火锅 (exactly these four characters, written correctly, in this order, left to right, one line) as huge chunky 3D letters standing on the wooden table right behind the hotpot, filling the upper third of the poster. The letters are made of translucent glossy red chili-oil jelly with a warm amber glow inside, tiny chili flakes and sesame seeds suspended in them, rounded bold soft shapes, catching the warm lantern light with bright highlights and soft reflections, casting real shadows onto the table. The food characters play with the letters: the tripe sheet lies on top of the first character, peeking down over its edge; a dried chili sits cross-legged on top of 火 waving; the cooked beef roll hangs from a stroke of 锅 with both tiny arms, swinging and laughing; a garlic clove slides down the slope of a stroke like a slide with arms up; two peppercorns peek out from between the letters. Wisps of steam rise from the hotpot and curl around the letters. In the lower half, the bubbling hotpot with the duck blood, tofu and other chilies waving up at the letters. Rich warm red, amber and gold palette, shallow depth of field, dramatic but cozy lighting, high-end 3D food commercial look, film grain. No other text anywhere, no subtitles, no logos, no humans.
画面要求：背景不透明，纸面或底色铺满整个画面，不要透明、镂空或黑色边角区域。

Generate a cinematic, premium food-character poster, vertical 3:4, using the attached reference image as the style/world and exact character design reference. Scene: a warm lantern-lit Chongqing hotpot restaurant with a big round dark iron Chongqing hotpot on a wooden table, glossy red chili-oil broth bubbling with steam. Photorealistic high-end 3D food commercial look, rich warm red, amber, and gold palette, shallow depth of field, dramatic but cozy lighting, subtle film grain.

Keep the food characters consistent with the reference: googly eyes with white eyeballs and black pupils, small toothless mouths, tiny arms and legs made of their own material. Include cooked fatty beef roll, flat dark velvety tripe sheet, duck blood cube, tofu cube with a cilantro leaf on its head, dried red chilies, Sichuan peppercorn clusters, garlic cloves, and scallion pieces.

The title must be a physical object in the scene: exactly four Simplified Chinese characters “重庆火锅”, written correctly in this exact order, left to right, one line. Make them huge chunky 3D letters standing on the wooden table directly behind the hotpot, filling the upper third of the poster. The letters are made of translucent glossy red chili-oil jelly, glowing warmly amber inside, with tiny chili flakes and sesame seeds suspended in the material. Rounded bold soft shapes, bright highlights, soft reflections, real shadows cast onto the table.

Character interactions with the letters: the tripe sheet lies on top of the first character, peeking down over its edge; a dried chili sits cross-legged on top of 火 waving; the cooked beef roll hangs from a stroke of 锅 with both tiny arms, swinging and laughing; a garlic clove slides down the slope of a stroke like a slide with arms up; two peppercorns peek out from between the letters. Wisps of steam rise from the hotpot and curl around the letters.

Lower half: bubbling hotpot with duck blood cube, tofu cube, dried chilies, peppercorn clusters, garlic cloves, scallion pieces and other chilies waving up at the letters. No humans. No other text anywhere, no subtitles, no logos.

Important canvas/background requirement: background must be fully opaque and fill the entire image edge to edge, with no transparency, cutouts, hollow areas, black corners, or empty borders.
